articles.title: Daniel Ellsberg’s Stories of Courage and Foreboding
articles.summary: In July 1971, Daniel Ellsberg, facing indictment for leaking classified Pentagon secrets to the press, publicly addressed reporters in Cambridge, Massachusetts. This disclosure of sensitive government documents ignited a major national controversy. It highlighted critical debates surrounding government transparency, national security, and the vital role of a free press in a democratic society.

articles.title: Major bridge in Kyiv damaged in Russian strikes
articles.summary: A Russian strike targeted Kyiv's Northern Bridge, suspending traffic and causing severe tailbacks for the third consecutive day. This latest assault reflects Moscow's ongoing strategy to disrupt daily life and critical infrastructure within the Ukrainian capital amidst the ongoing conflict, impacting civilian movement and resilience.

articles.title: Kashi all set to host 3-day IAF air show; PM Modi may come
articles.summary: Kashi will host a three-day Indian Air Force air show starting October 24, with the Prime Minister and Defence Minister expected to attend. This event will showcase the IAF's aerial prowess and commitment to national security, offering aspirants a chance to witness military capabilities firsthand and understand the strategic importance of such displays for defence preparedness.

articles.title: sci-report-analyzer added to PyPI
articles.summary: A new local web application, built with NiceGUI and SQLite, helps track and evaluate researchers. It systematically monitors their publications across various sources, ranks the quality of their publishing venues, and organizes comprehensive digital folders for each researcher. These folders include tags, personal notes, and stored PDFs, streamlining the process of academic profiling and assessment.

articles.title: Batman: Justice Year in The Daily LITG 3rd October 2026
articles.summary: The Daily LITG for October 3rd, 2026, highlights 'Batman: Justice Year,' a new comic series created by Joshua Williamson and Bruno Redondo. This update covers upcoming releases in the comic book industry, specifically focusing on a globally recognized superhero franchise. While not a core Defence, National, or Sci & Tech topic, it represents developments within international popular culture and media landscape.

articles.title: Watch: Massive rush, traffic jams hit Himachal, Uttarakhand roads as tourists head to hills on long weekend
articles.summary: Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand witnessed massive tourist rush and severe traffic jams on their roads over the recent long weekend. Thousands flocked to popular hill stations, leading to significant congestion. This recurring issue highlights the challenges of managing large tourist influx and infrastructure during peak seasons in these scenic northern states, impacting local administration and emergency services.

articles.title: IG Defence tests solid rocket motors for indigenous JWALA micro-missile
articles.summary: JWALA, a new scalable hard-kill counter-UAS interceptor, has successfully completed crucial propulsion tests, marking a significant development milestone. Designed to complement existing electronic and conventional air-defence systems, JWALA aims to provide an effective physical countermeasure against enemy drones. This advancement is vital for strengthening national air defence capabilities against evolving unmanned aerial threats.
